status: PREPARED V2; independent re-review required; neither CLI executed
prerequisites: Root independently reviews exact candidate and all baselines/diffs; candidate frozen code and inputs remain exact.

The real staged Git diagnostic command must be exactly git diff --cached --check with actual worktree cwd, separately retained full command/stdin/stdout/stderr/exit, exit0 or2 and empty stderr. Static LF predicates are never substituted.

Root creates, retains and stages the actual before-whitespace root manifest and its listed original/copy bank records. The candidate does not invent that future manifest or approve any root output category. All root warnings must belong to its files records.
The actual current canonical-build proof supplies CSV output hashes; review source/semantic/full-freeze and retention gates remain independent prerequisites.

Every output directory must be absent and outside candidate, worktree, entire active batch and manifest directory. Caller captures the candidate command and complete stdout/stderr/exit in a separate fresh sibling execution directory, never overwriting a prior attempt.

prepare creates exact full-input copies plus progressive partial-classification checkpoints. On failure keep the entire output and failure.json; use another explicitly named directory on retry. Never delete or repurpose partial outputs.

audit requires unchanged prepared pins, review freeze, root manifest, raw diagnostic and staged file bytes; it reruns actual git diff --cached --check and independently repeats all predicates. It does not use prepare as an approval.

The original raw staged diagnostic and before-whitespace root manifest were actually available and retained during bounded predicate tests. These tests did not query the index or run prepare/audit. Root must use the applicable exact current actual command/evidence boundary after independent re-review; later changes require a fresh boundary.

After audit root may bank exact outputs under separately reviewed banking tooling. Any subsequent staging change requires a fresh verification boundary; this candidate does not cover its own later banking.
source_policy: Four explicitly described full physical text sources must exactly match original current manifest records and frozen copies. All complete original bytes and all discovered whole-fragment or complete-line ranges are retained, with all matching witnesses rather than invented unique attribution.

Review paths require exact current freeze pin+full working/staged/frozen byte equality AND a strict literal predicate. Root bank paths require actual original/copy manifest equality AND strict diff-context or literal empty-LF EOF only.

CSV requires current actual builder hash and CR-before-LF. Ordinary EOF stays literal empty-LF. Fully parsed complete balanced unified diff may own exactly one-space blank context lines, including an actual terminal all-context tail with mixed trailing/EOF warnings. Each file header pair must have a complete hunk.

Physical whole-range provenance preserves strict literal empty-LF EOF and additionally owns a nonblank complete fragment ending in an exact empty CRLF tail. All full original aliases/ranges and frozen/current/staged byte equality remain mandatory. The complete-source-line fallback never owns EOF. Spaces/tabs/nonempty EOF tails, printed source lines and unowned whitespace reject.
Unknown categories, unsupported diff framing, ambiguous framing, changed sources, out-of-range lines, duplicate warning identities, missing root provenance or changed index/head fail closed.
root_alias_identity: Retain supplied and absolute worktree/review/root-manifest aliases plus initial resolved targets and device/inode identity. Read root manifest through the supplied alias. Recheck all root aliases/identities after constructor setup and after all final full input-byte checks. Symlink roots are supported only while their target identity stays exact; same-byte retargets and same-path identity replacement reject.
